groups.title: The Shadow Guard
groups.sub: Three of its members so far

groups.title: Beyond the Guard
groups.sub: Allies, enemies, and the ones who came before

characters.name: Abhimanyu Rathore
characters.role: The heart of the Shadow Guard
characters.quote: Can I be the person this world can trust?
characters.bio: The main protagonist. After losing his fiancée, Abhimanyu has lost trust in himself, and his guilt is what drives him not to lose anyone else.

characters.name: Ishani Sanghvi
characters.quote: The world as I know it is full of sick men, and I will treat them my way.
characters.bio: One of the strongest women in the astral world. But can Abhimanyu make her see the world the way she doesn't want to see it?

characters.name: Kunal Nasser
characters.quote: We have seen wars and battles, chaos and destruction. Will humans ever stop?
characters.bio: Leader of the Shadow Guard. Will he be able to lead his team through their greater quests?

characters.name: Alexander Schiss
characters.quote: Every human is inherently evil. We just pretend, so that we can achieve our goals.
characters.bio: Who is this guy? He looks like Abhimanyu but claims no relation. What's his deal?

characters.name: Aadhya Mira
characters.quote: You have to be the trust the world needs, Abhi.
characters.bio: The emotional anchor we all need.

characters.name: Raj Vetramani
characters.quote: Protecting the weak is my duty.
characters.bio: A hero who defines heroism. But will he always be remembered as one?

characters.name: Shan Zhuang
characters.quote: The world needs hierarchy, and I will always remain at the top of it.
characters.bio: Can Shan's obsession build the world he wants, or will it end badly?
